author: N6rL
content: Blocked by L6 (Pydantic RawDocument) and L7 (serde RawDocument). This is the Phase 1 membrane enforcement from PIPELINE.md. Scope: (1) a curated fixture corpus of real JSON RawDocument payloads — minimum 4 fixtures: clean academic PDF, messy OCR scan, web article, and edge cases (no DOI, empty blocks array, unusual Unicode, missing-optional permutations); (2) a Python test that generates/serializes all fixtures; (3) a Rust test that deserializes every fixture — if Rust rejects any fixture that Python produces, the membrane is broken; (4) round-trip stability test — Rust deserializes then re-serializes, assert semantic JSON equality (parse-and-compare not string-compare, needs a small utility); (5) the negative test: adding a field to the Python Pydantic model but not the Rust serde struct should cause a deserialization error on the fixture, proving deny_unknown_fields catches drift. AC: all 4+ fixtures round-trip clean; the negative drift test fails as expected (demonstrates the guard works); CI step runs this check. This check must go red before any agent can drift the membrane silently.
